candidates.tagline: The stadium that needed 18 pink grow lights just to have grass
candidates.story: AT&T Stadium — a billion-dollar indoor NFL dome in Arlington, Texas — installed 18 pink LED grow lights suspended from the ceiling and shipped Colorado-grown grass 800 miles to North Texas, raising the entire playing surface 24 inches above the concrete floor, all because FIFA insists on natural turf for World Cup matches.
candidates.why_funny: They built a magnificent roofed stadium and then had to construct a full-scale greenhouse inside it to host a sport that normally happens outdoors.
candidates.alt: AT&T Stadium interior entirely bathed in pink-purple glow from 18 LED grow lights suspended above a green grass soccer field

candidates.tagline: When your rebrand is so bad the vandals fix it for free
candidates.story: UK retailer WH Smith — a 230-year high street institution — was rebranded to 'TGJones' by its new owners in 2025; the name proved so universally despised that someone spray-painted 'WHSmith' back over the new sign in Richmond, and it remained there for over a week while 150 stores face closure.
candidates.why_funny: Three-quarters of British people hate the new name so much that actual citizens took to spray paint to undo the rebrand themselves.
candidates.alt: Blue TGJones store sign with 'WHSmith' spray-painted in white graffiti over the logo on a UK high street, next to a Post Office
